{{AttributeInfobox |image1 = AggroIcon.png |type = Status Effect |effects = Forced Targeting
Red Aura |sandbox = Yes |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|AggroIcon.png|Aggro}} }} ==Description== '''Aggro''' is a status effect that makes towers target an enemy with it instead of the enemy they should with their targeting. ==Mechanics== When an enemy has '''Aggro''', it will be targeted by towers even if it should target a different enemy based on their targeting. For example, if there are two [[Minigunner]]s placed down, one set to First Enemy and second on Last Enemy, '''Aggro''' will make them target the enemy with it instead. If multiple '''Aggro''' enemies are in range, they will be targeted based on the tower's targeting. '''Aggro''' also gives enemies a red aura. ==Enemy List== The following enemies have '''Aggro''' by default: *[[Monkey]] The following enemies also have '''Aggro''', but only through ability usage: *[[Molten Warlord]] (''War Cry'') *[[Yeti]] (''Feral Rush'') *[[Void Brute]] (''Bound Crush'') The following event enemies also have '''Aggro''', but only through ability usage: *[[Titus]] (''Dark Decoy'', [[Hexscape Event|Hexscape]]) *[[Corrupted Titus]] (''Dark Decoy'', [[Hexscape Event|Hexscape]]) The following enemies can spawn with '''Aggro''', but do not have it by default: *[[Fallen
